acip: DES DE MA THAG RKYEN BYAS PA LAS GNYUG MA'I GTZO SEMS BDE BA'I NGO BOR SONG BA LA BDE BA CHEN PO ZER, MDO LUGS LA BDE BA YIN NA GTZO SEMS MA YIN PAS KHYAB PAR BZHED KYANG , SNGAGS LUGS LA GTZO SEMS DANG BDE BA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD,
wylie: des de ma thag rkyen byas pa las gnyug ma'i gtso sems bde ba'i ngo bor song ba la bde ba chen po zer, mdo lugs la bde ba yin na gtso sems ma yin pas khyab par bzhed kyang , sngags lugs la gtso sems dang bde ba'i gzhi mthun yod
english: This in turn acts as one of those mental causes for an immediate mental result, and the main mind, the primal mind, takes on a nature of great bliss: this in fact is what is called "the great bliss."  In the system of the open teachings, it is an axiom that something which is bliss can never also be main mind.  But in the system of the secret teachings, there can exist one thing which is both main mind and also bliss.
